system.description: Tiny flying robots, in the shape of mosquitos with concerningly long, metal proboscises, fly towards the heroes in groups of three. (2 per hero.)
system.tactics: They swarm toward the heroes and gang up on the nearest un-sampled heroes. Once a hero has been sampled, the Skeeterbots lose interest in them. If there are no un-sampled heroes, the Skeeterbots self-destruct, Attacking each nearby target — friend and foe alike — by rolling their die.

system.description: If their Attack damages a hero, they analyze the blood they draw, instantly uploading the results to a server… somewhere. A hero with appropriate abilities might be able to detect the signal. Keep track of which heroes have their DNA captured this way — used to create clones in Scene 3.
